prose: A New York Times excerpt indexed by Techmeme describes handcrafted development choices for Grand Theft Auto VI, contrasting them with AI and procedural generation. The full feature was inaccessible. The excerpt’s production counts, definitions and scope of AI use were not independently checked, so no claim about every development tool is established.
highlights: Evidence is an indexed feature excerpt
Definition of AI use remains unclear
No universal statement about all tools is inferred
